Application Data.NAME: Book Nook Publishing
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Book Nook Publishing operates as a retail bookstore and magazine outlet, offering a diverse selection of new and used books, magazines, and literary merchandise. In addition to our physical storefront, we maintain a robust e-commerce platform that enables customers to purchase items online. Our business focuses on curating a welcoming environment for community engagement, featuring author signings, book clubs, and special events. We prioritize customer experience and implement strong inventory controls to reduce loss and enhance operational efficiency. With annual sales not exceeding $500,000, we adhere to strict cybersecurity protocols to safeguard customer data and mitigate online risks associated with our e-commerce activities.
